description_en: Queries the policies for automatically triggered tasks
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-cron-job-policy-serverless --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id 8006e51c-dab3-4602-bc69-4f728002c6ce --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCronJobPolicyServerless

parameters.help_en: The ID of the serverless cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduled task
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of records to return on each page. Valid values:

30

50

100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围：
30
50
100

默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

Action.description_en: A system parameter. Set the value to ModifyDBClusterServerlessConf

AllowShutDown.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable No-activity Suspension. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled (default)
AllowShutDown.description_zh:
是否开启无活动暂停。取值：

true：开启

false：关闭（默认）

CronExpression.description_en: The Cron expression for the scheduled task

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

JobId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled task

ScaleApRoNumMax.description_en: The maximum number of read-only IMCI nodes. Valid values: 1 to 15
ScaleApRoNumMax.description_zh: 只读列存节点个数上限。取值范围：1～15

ScaleApRoNumMin.description_en: The minimum number of read-only IMCI nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15
ScaleApRoNumMin.description_zh: 只读列存节点个数下限。取值范围：0～15

ScaleMax.description_en: The maximum capacity. The value must be from 1 to 32. Unit: PCU

ScaleMin.description_en: The minimum capacity. The value must be from 0.25 to 32 and less than or equal to the maximum capacity. Unit: PolarDB Capacity Unit (PCU)
ScaleMin.description_zh: 最小值:0.25~32 PCU，且最小值 <= 最大值。单位：PCU

ScaleRoNumMax.description_en: The maximum number of read-only nodes. The value must be greater than or equal to the minimum value. Valid values: 0 to 15
ScaleRoNumMax.description_zh: 只读节点个数的伸缩上限0~15个可选, 且不能大于上限的值。取值范围：0~15

ScaleRoNumMin.description_en: The minimum number of read-only nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15
ScaleRoNumMin.description_zh: 只读节点个数伸缩下限。取值范围：0~15

SecondsUntilAutoPause.description_en: The detection period for No-activity Suspension. The value must be a multiple of 5. Valid values: 5 to 1440. Unit: minutes
SecondsUntilAutoPause.description_zh: 无活动暂停的检测时长。取值范围：5~1440。单位分钟。检测时长必须是5分钟的倍数

ServerlessRuleCpuEnlargeThreshold.description_en: The CPU utilization threshold for scaling up. Valid values: 40 to 100. Unit: %

ServerlessRuleCpuShrinkThreshold.description_en: The CPU utilization threshold for scaling down. Valid values: 10 to 100. Unit: %. The difference between the scale-up threshold and the scale-down threshold must be 30 or greater
ServerlessRuleCpuShrinkThreshold.description_zh: cpu弹降阈值。最小值:10~100 %，且最大值 - 最小值 >= 30

ServerlessRuleMode.description_en:
The elasticity sensitivity. Valid values:

normal: standard

flexible: sensitive
ServerlessRuleMode.description_zh:
弹性灵敏度。取值：

normal：标准
flexible：灵敏

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format and in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

working: The scheduled task is running.

finish: The scheduled task is complete
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。 取值范围如下：

working：周期任务生效中
finish：周期任务已完成

PageSize.description_en:
The number of records on each page. Valid values:

30

50

100

Default value: 30
PageSize.description_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围：
30
50
100

默认值为30
